{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Bread|Bread]]

==Ingredients==

* 275 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] [[Cookbook:Flour|high protein flour]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Yeast|instant yeast]] 
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ teaspoons [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano powder]]
* ½ teaspoons [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary powder]]
* ½ teaspoons [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* 175 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]

==Procedure==
# Combine flour, yeast, salt, powdered oregano, rosemary powder, and thyme.
# Gradually mix the water into the flour, [[Cookbook:Kneading|kneading]] until elastic. Let stand 30 minutes.
# Weigh out 100 grams of dough, and let rest for 10 minutes. Shape the dough into a long loaf. Repeat with remaining dough.
# Transfer loaves to a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] sprinkled with flour. Make slices in the top with a sharp knife or blade. Let rise 50 minutes until fluffy.
# Spray loaves with water. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] 25 minutes in a 200°C oven until cooked through.
